_: The gift guide /cadeaux-pokemon (amazon.fr, lib/amazonGifts): by budget, only what can be bought at once (buy: "now", checked on the product's page; a box by invitation never shows). A product: its ASIN (amazon.fr/dp, found by a web search, never a script on amazon.fr), its kind (a sealed box: its Poképédia picture in `pic`, hidden without one; gear: drawn, lib/gearArt), who it's for, one line. No prices on the page (they move): the budget is the public price's band.
